_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Surround on a {width}x{height} grid.
Iwo ni player {player_id}. Aṣẹ tuntun: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' tàbi w/s/a/d.
Ipo: ku ṣaṣẹ gbogbo eniyan mi. Trails ni ikú; igbo ogba pa; head-on crashes pa mẹ́rin.

game_action.invalid_death: Olùṣeré {player_id} kú nítorí ìgbésẹ̀ tí kò bá òfin mu.

outcome.survived_win: Ẹlẹsẹ {player_id} yè; gbogbo àwọn yòókù já lulẹ̀.
outcome.all_crashed: Gbogbo àwọn tó ń ṣeré náà ló já lulẹ̀ lẹ́ẹ̀kan náà.
outcome.outlived: Akọrin gbé ogbẹ̀yin ju gbogbo wọn lọ.
outcome.turn_limit: Ìlà ìyí ti dé - ẹni tó bá pẹ́ jù lọ nínú wọn ló máa borí.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Awọn ẹgbẹ ipo ipari (ti o dara julọ→ti o buru julọ): {groups}
